# Heating

Shows a heating `climate.*` entity's **measured and target temperatures** and adjusts the target.

<div class="widget-previews">
<figure><a href="../img/gallery/heating_default_glow.png"><img src="../img/gallery/heating_default_glow.png" alt="Heating (default), Glow style" loading="lazy" width="230" height="240" style="width: 184px"></a></figure>
</div>

## Entities

| Entity | Domains |
| --- | --- |
| Thermostat | `climate.*` |
| Actual temperature | `sensor.*` |

## Requirements

None beyond the entities.

## Options

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Heating style | full arc, or a semi-arc with mode buttons |
| Arc opening | semi-arc only: left, right, top or bottom |

## On the panel

- A tap on the card switches the thermostat on or off.
- **+** and **−** step the target temperature.

## Size

- Minimum: **220 × 200 px**.
- Maximum: **480 px × 480 px**, capped by the display's dashboard area.

The minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size. [Choose your display](../choose-display.md) lists the dashboard geometry; [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains spacing and touch targets.
